_comment_verified_2026_08_05_: The five entries below were originally added from model background knowledge with recalled citations. On 2026-08-05 every one was checked against the publisher or PubMed record: authors, title, venue, volume, pages and DOI all matched. Belin, Sammler, Kanwisher, Craig and Seeley are PRIMARY-PARTIAL — citation confirmed and abstract read, full text paywalled. Phelps & LeDoux was then supplied as a PDF and read in full. Verifying a citation is not the same as verifying the claim hung on it: the emotion network these partly supported was dropped because no source tested its grouping.
